{"description":"PLANNED 2026-10-29, increment 2 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory (epoch:planned-cues-reach-the-agent-and-are-counted).

WHAT A CUE IS HERE: a sentence in a reply's cue fields (`loop_hint`, `hint`, `next`, `nudge`, `next_step`, at any depth) that names a served tool, or a served skill to fetch, other than the tool just called — the definition the recall pilot's baseline used (fact:in-the-recall-pilot-agents-followed-4-percent-of-reflow2s-cues-within-five-calls-2026-10-29). Plus the agent-side cue the connect-time instructions carry (cap:the-first-read-cue-reaches-the-agent-before-its-first-call).

THE ID is derived, not hand-assigned at ~40 emit sites: `<field>/<target>`, where target is a tool name or `get_skill:<skill>` (e.g. `loop_hint/set_decision_status`, `next/loop_status`, `instructions/graph_report_markdown`). Stable because the field and the named call are reflow2's own vocabulary. A tool name with an underscore is matched as a whole word; a one-word tool name (genesis, answers) only when back-quoted, so English words are not miscounted; a skill only after `get_skill` or when hyphenated. The ids ride the reply in `_meta["reflow2/cues"]` (protocol metadata, not shown to the model, so naming the cue adds no cue fatigue) and are written on the call's ledger line (`cues`).

THE COUNT: computed at report time from the ledger, per seat (the session): an offer is FOLLOWED WITHIN 5 when one of that seat's next five calls is the named call (get_skill with that skill for a skill), FOLLOWED AT ALL when any later call in the window is. An offer on a seat that made only one call in the window is UNATTRIBUTABLE (a per-request seat on the sessionless transport cannot be followed), counted apart rather than as not followed. usage_report's tally gains a `cues` block: totals and, per cue id, offered / followed_within_5 / followed_at_all / unattributable and which tools offered it. The same report, no new tool.

VERBS ONLY (req:telemetry-carries-usage-never-design-content): a cue id holds a field name and a tool or skill name, never the sentence, a node id or an argument.","name":"Every cue naming a next call carries an id, the usage ledger records it offered, and usage_report counts whether the session's later calls acted on it","provenance":"authored","status":"verified","tier":"operational"}
